Definition and fixed transformation: Sum of daily concentrations throughout the year ÷ 365.25 (μg m⁻³); model IQR, 0.678107947271523 μg m⁻³.
Source and traceability: Childs et al. (2022), doi:10.1021/acs.est.2c02934; archived administrative summaries. Extraction release/date not archived.

Definition and fixed transformation: Composite index for 2006–2010, standardised across counties in the six states (mean 0, SD 1); higher values indicate greater disadvantage.
Source and traceability: ACS 2006–2010 five-year estimates, linked through NHGIS. Original extract ID and complete index specification not archived.

Definition and fixed transformation: Reported counts, including zeros, retained; suppressed counts jointly imputed over 1–9 under state-total constraints.
Source and traceability: CDC WONDER UCD 1999–2020, D76. State query: 26 July 2026; county query log not archived.

Definition and fixed transformation: County population in the corresponding year; its logarithm used as the model offset.
Source and traceability: Corresponding annual populations in the archived CDC WONDER mortality exports; matched by county, year and cause.

Definition and fixed transformation: Proportion aged 65 years or older from the ACS five-year estimate ending in each study year; standardised using a fixed scale.
Source and traceability: ACS five-year releases 2009–2020, table B01001; rolling five-year windows ending in each study year.

Definition and fixed transformation: ACS population divided by 2020 county land area (km²), transformed as log(1+density) and standardised.
Source and traceability: ACS five-year population, 2009–2020, divided by land area from the 2020 Census Gazetteer county file.

Definition and fixed transformation: Proportion of area at drought category D1 or higher during the fire season, standardised using a fixed scale.
Source and traceability: Archived monthly county D0–D4 files, 2006–2020. Upstream product identifier and release date not archived.

Definition and fixed transformation: Mean May–October air temperature, converted from °F to °C before fixed-scale standardisation.
Source and traceability: NOAA NCEI Climate at a Glance county series, tavg; six months ending October, 2006–2020. Retrieval date not archived.

Definition and fixed transformation: Total May–October precipitation, converted from inches to mm before fixed-scale standardisation.
Source and traceability: NOAA NCEI Climate at a Glance county series, pcp; six months ending October, 2006–2020. Retrieval date not archived.

Definition and fixed transformation: Total PM₂.₅ minus smoke PM₂.₅, standardised using a fixed scale.
Source and traceability: CDC Tracking/EPA Downscaler exports; configured service 53mz-4zqd, field pm25_pop_pred. Exact extraction release not archived.

Definition and fixed transformation: Annual ozone variable, standardised using a fixed scale.
Source and traceability: CDC Tracking/EPA Downscaler exports; configured service 3vxk-q2jk, field o3_pop_pred. Native unit metadata and extraction release not archived.

Definition and fixed transformation: Area- and time-weighted mean during May–October, modelled in units of 10 °C; quality-control rules are given in S6.
Source and traceability: NASA MODIS/Terra MOD11A2.061, Collection 6.1; Earth Engine collection MODIS/061/MOD11A2.
